note: Seventh shop of the B07 covered arcade (glass skylight, honey limestone, dark oak joinery, as on the exterior): the corner shop, with butter-yellow walls and a grey flagstone floor. LANDMARK: the huge curved bay shop window full of cakes. The oak doorway on the far left shows the cream-and-cobalt general store with its jars (way back); the doorway on the far right shows the teal fabric shop with its shelves of cloth bolts (next shop). Feminine nouns on the left, masculine on the right. Zoom: the model town on its table (z1).
